text: Don't start vibe coding with Claude code unless you've installed these four plugins. The first is Superpowers, which has almost 300,000 stars and stops Claude from jumping straight into code. It asks what you're actually building, turns it into a spec you sign off on, and hands the work to sub-agents that write the tests first, so it can run for hours without drifting off the plan. The second is the Carpathian Skills, which is one Claude.md file built from Andre Carpathian's complaint that models write a thousand lines when a hundred would do. Four rules. Think before coding, keep it simple, touch only what you are asked to and prove it works. The third is I have a DHD, which stops Claude burying the answer. No great question, no hope this helps. The next action first, steps numbered and lists capped at five. And finally, there's Claude Octopus, which hands the same task to up to 12 other models, like Codex, Copilot and Grock, and flags every place they disagree before you ship. So if you want to try them all out for yourselves, just comment senior and I'll send the links to you directly.
